This update fixes crashes during large resizes and WebP saves, improves large-image navigation, and adds optional HEIC library support.

### Fixes

- Oversized resizes now show an error before allocating memory. Cancelled or outdated results cannot overwrite a changed document. Related to issue 212.
- WebP saves explain when an image exceeds the format's size limit instead of crashing, while preserving existing files. Related to issue 207.
- Large images fit properly when opened, and zooming out works below 10%. Small images retain their intended initial size. Related to issue 211.
- Debug Info settings survive restarts and are now under Preferences > Interface. Related to issue 209.
- Fixed timing drift that could leave a 60 FPS limit running below its target. Related to issue 203.

### Features and interface

- Added processing cancellation and blocked conflicting actions while work runs. CPU resizing may need to finish its current step before stopping. Related to issue 212.
- Choose your own compatible libheif DLL in Preferences > Optional Features and check its HEIC opening and saving support. PaintFE does not bundle or download HEVC codecs. Related to issue 196.
- Replaced duplicate CJK font downloads with one universal pack. Related to issue 210.
